newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down seven cents on London's fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down seven cents on London's fall.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down seven cents at 14.63 ringgit ($5.89) a kg, pulling back after an 11-cent rise on Tuesday, traders said.
They said the fall reflected a $30 drop on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight.
"Small bids at the opening also dragged the price lower," a trader said, noting initial bids for 40 tonnes against offers for 117 tonnes.
Final turnover was 85 tonnes, down from 130 on Tuesday, and buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
Traders said they expected the recent market volatility to continue given the similar trend in London.
The local price premium over the LME narrowed to $25 a tonne against $35 previously, traders said.
